newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Gencor, Avgold to merge two mines.
newsitem.headline: Gencor, Avgold to merge two mines.

text.p: South African mining houses Gencor Ltd and Avgold Ltd said on Tuesday that they intended merging their respective wholly-owned contiguous gold mining operations Fairview and the Eastern Transvaal Consolidated (ETC) division..

The groups said in a joint statement the new entity would be a significant world greenstone gold operation, capable of producing more than 150,000 ounces of gold per annum at a cash cost of around $250 per ounce.
The life expectancy of the new operation was more than 20 years.
"It is anticipated that the transaction will be concluded within the next three months following a due diligence exercise and the signature of binding agreements," the statement said.
The combined operation will be 55 percent owned by Avgold and 45 percent by Gencor and will be managed by a team independent of both companies, appointed by the shareholders.

"Subject to the due diligence Gencor will in addition contribute 180 million rand in cash to the combined entity to be used for the funding of various capital expenditure requirements," according to the statement.
It said the merger allowed access to the deeper ETC reefs from the existing Fairview intrastructure which could eliminate the need for additional shafts to be sunk.
Another advantage would be the synergies achieved in underground workings, reducing anticipated expenditure on reef and haulage development.
